`blank-presentation.pptx` is a synthetic, empty three-slide presentation generated from Flyfish File Viewer's public `chart-fixture.mjs` test helper. Flyfish File Viewer is licensed under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer/blob/main/LICENSE

The regression test inserts its own synthetic grouped text into the fixture in memory. No user presentation is included.

`office-sample.docx`, `office-sample.xlsx` and `office-sample.pptx` are the public demo files `quarterly-operations-report.docx`, `financial-sample.xlsx` and `sample-presentation.pptx` from [Flyfish File Viewer's demo](https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer/tree/main/apps/viewer-demo/public/example/en). They are included for renderer regression testing under the upstream project's Apache-2.0 license; see [LICENSE](https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer/blob/main/LICENSE).

`FileEncByName.rar` and `HeaderEnc1234.rar` are small public test archives from [node-unrar.js](https://github.com/YuJianrong/node-unrar.js/tree/master/testFiles) (MIT wrapper license). They test per-file and encrypted-header passwords; their test passwords are documented in the upstream tests.
